name: Wiltshire February 2024

venue.name: Olympiad Leisure Centre
venue.details: Main Sports Hall, on the bottom floor.

information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

This is a one-day competition with a heavy focus on relaxed 6x6, 7x7 and Megaminx time limits, so if you've always wanted to get an average in any of these events, this is the competition for you! Parents, if you're brave enough, you are more than welcome to give it a go!
